modal.title: Build plan
modal.subtitle: Set when learning can happen and how much time is required.
modal.helper: This creates instructional slots on the calendar. Slots are safe to edit and can be filled with lessons later.

planningScope.title: What do you want to build?
planningScope.subtitle: Choose the kind of plan that matches your goal. You can add subjects or curriculum later.

full_year.label: A full-year learning plan
full_year.description: Set learning days across the year for one or more children. Reserve capacity first; assign subjects or lessons when you're ready.

one_subject.label: A plan for one subject
one_subject.description: Schedule a single subject and optionally attach curriculum or material.

placeholders_only.label: Just placeholder learning days
placeholders_only.description: Create generic learning slots with no subject yet. Fill them later with math, reading, projects, or anything else.

build_from_material.label: Build from material / syllabus
build_from_material.description: Upload, paste, or link to a syllabus or list — we'll map lessons onto your calendar.

useASource.title: Choose method
useASource.subtitle: Choose where your plan content comes from.

placeholders.label: Add just a cadence for now
placeholders.description: e.g. Math Tuesdays 9 a.m. for 12 weeks

upload.label: Upload material
upload.description: Syllabus, lesson plan, PDF workbook, etc. — we'll parse it to create the correct number of lessons with details like units/topics pre-assigned

link.label: Add a link
link.description: e.g. Khan Academy unit — we'll import and create structured events.

paste.label: Paste list
paste.description:
Paste plain text like Unit 1: Foundations of Algebra & Linear Relationships covers:
• Evaluating algebraic expressions
• Combining like terms
• Understanding variables as representations of unknowns and changing quantities
• Writing linear equations in slope-intercept and standard form
Unit 2: Systems of...

who.title: Who is this plan for?
who.subtitle: Choose one child or plan for the whole family.

subjects.title: Subjects
subjects.subtitle: Slots will be created per subject on eligible days.

blocks.title: Weekly blocks
blocks.subtitle: Define recurring time blocks that will generate instructional slots.

empty.title: No blocks yet.
empty.body: Add a block like "Math • Mon/Wed/Fri • 9:00–10:00" to generate instructional slots.

dates.title: Dates
dates.subtitle: Set the plan start and end date.

targets.title: Targets (optional)
targets.subtitle: Use targets to check whether your plan meets requirements.

breaks.title: Breaks & holidays
breaks.subtitle: Exclude dates where slots should not be created.

preview.title: Preview
preview.subtitle: Estimated instructional time based on your blocks and exclusions.

replaceEmptySlots.title: Update instructional slots?
replaceEmptySlots.body: This will update only empty instructional slots generated by this plan. Scheduled lessons will not be changed.

removeSlots.title: Remove instructional slots?
removeSlots.body: This removes only generated instructional slots. Scheduled lessons will remain.

calendar.slotTooltipEmpty: This is an instructional slot created by Build plan. Fill it with a lesson or leave it open.
calendar.slotTooltipFilled: This slot contains a scheduled lesson. It will not be changed by future plan updates.

modal.title: Build Curriculum
modal.subtitle: Create a structured unit with sequenced lessons.
modal.helper: You can schedule lessons into instructional slots or add them to the backlog.

weeks.label: Weeks
weeks.helper: How many weeks should this unit span?

minutesPerDay.label: Minutes per day
minutesPerDay.helper: Used to estimate pacing and scheduling.

useSlots.label: Use available instructional slots
useSlots.helper: Fill lessons into your Build plan schedule when possible.

notices.noSlotsFound: No instructional slots were available in this range. Lessons were scheduled using open availability.
notices.usedSlotsAndFallback: Placed {used} lessons into instructional slots. Scheduled {fallback} more using open availability.

modal.title: Extract Lessons & Assignments
modal.subtitle: Review and attach extracted content to a course.
modal.helper: Extracted items are drafts until they are attached to a unit.

empty.title: Nothing to extract.
empty.body: Try a different file or upload a syllabus with clearer headings and dates.

section.title: Course structure
section.subtitle: Define what is taught in this course and how it progresses.

empty.title: No units yet.
empty.body: Start by generating curriculum, importing a syllabus, or adding your first unit.

emptySlot.tooltip: This slot was generated by Build plan. Fill it with a lesson or leave it open.

filledSlot.title: Scheduled lesson
filledSlot.tooltip: This lesson is linked to curriculum and will not be changed by future plan updates.

manualLesson.title: Lesson (manual)
manualLesson.tooltip: This lesson is not linked to curriculum.

backlog.title: Lesson backlog
backlog.subtitle: Lessons that are not yet scheduled.

empty.title: Backlog is empty.
empty.body: Add lessons from a unit or import a syllabus to get started.
